CLAS People

This collection of websites includes more than 500 faculty and staff websites across the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences.

These sites provide opportunities to showcase research interests, publications, biographies, contact information, and professional achievements. Faculty and staff maintain their own content and are responsible for adhering to university branding and accessibility standards.

Resources and Guidance:

- Web Content Accessibility Guide

- CLAS WordPress Help and How-To

- UF’s Electronic Information Technology and Communication Accessibility Policy

- UF’s Brand and User Experience Policy for Digital Properties
